_about: External tools the kit references but never bundles. Fetched at install time, opt-in, into ~/.ai-dev-kit/external/<id>/. Every entry needs a CREDITS.md row. tests/install-kit.external.test.js enforces this. No keys, tokens or secrets in this file.

refs.name: Shopify AI Toolkit
refs.refNote: Live pull by design: skills are never stored here, so no pin. The installer records the commit it pulled.

refs.name: Obscura
restrictions: default build only: never the stealth builds
loopback only, never expose the CDP port

refs.name: FreeLLMAPI
refs.postInstall: the kit only fetches the router's source. Start it by its own README (Quick start or Docker), then put its key in ~/.ai-dev-kit/.env as UNIFIED_API_KEY; /api-mode free reads it from there.
